reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Audits whether a field, enum, flag, or API contract retains one declared meaning across storage, domain models, services, APIs, events, caches, jobs, clients, interfaces, analytics, tests, and rollout controls.
neutralIntentExamples: trace a nullable boolean through a migration, serializers, older clients, metrics, and tests

state-by-path compatibility matrix with release decision and unresolved evidence
failureBehavior: reports an audit as inconclusive when the governing contract is absent instead of inferring semantics from one implementation

materialRisks: silent coercion or defaulting can corrupt behavior while all components still compile
older clients, stale caches, delayed jobs, and analytics transforms can preserve obsolete semantics after the primary path changes
